(A) THE OUTPUT MUX -- exact, falsify on pixels. With LIGHTING_ENABLE set and SEPARATE_SPECULAR clear, silicon folds the lit specular into oD0 and puts the front vertex specular in oD1, under a vertex program as under fixed function. (B) THE LIGHT LOOP -- judge on the light term's magnitude, NOT on the pixel count.
